data.narrative:
Terran Robotics is a Seed-stage company in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Zach Dwiel and Danny Weddle. The target sits within a sector comprising 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics. However, peer-median valuation is not applicable here: while 11 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet narrow stage and tier filters, making a reliable comparable set unavailable.

Our analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which uses Terran's $256K total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $640K. Given single-method triangulation, we construct a range incorporating modest uncertainty: $544K (low), $640K (median), and $736K (high).

The valuation range of $544K to $736K is supported by the capital raised and standard progression mechanics. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently narrow peer comparables in the robotics sector at this stage, which limits cross-validation against market transactions. Any updated analysis would benefit from (1) expanded peer data at Seed stage, (2) founder track record specifics, and (3) technical differentiation documentation.
